blurb: Jersey Shore Cruises offers party boat experiences including The Salty Palm, Cape May Party Cruises, and Wildwood Sip-n-Slide Pontoons. Guests can enjoy music, dancing, swimming, and bar hopping on the water. The boats accommodate groups from 10 to 49 passengers and are suitable for events like birthdays, bachelorette parties, and family outings.

extraNote: Trip Protection allows guests to reschedule or receive a refund if a cruise is canceled by Jersey Shore Cruises due to severe weather. · If Jersey Shore Cruises cancels a cruise due to weather or unforeseen circumstances, including mechanical issues or marina closures, guests will receive a full value credit voucher. · A refund to the original payment method will be issued only if Trip Protection was purchased. · Cruises will only be canceled for unsafe weather conditions such as severe storms, high winds, or strong currents. · Because weather can change quickly, we monitor conditions closely and make all safety decisions in real time. · Gift card sales are final and non-refundable.

quotes.author: Robert Elder
quotes.text: First time ever out on a cycle cruise or much less a boat. Was an amazing surprise party for my brother and I was throughly impressed. Firstly, the captain and his future wife greeted us and were extremely friendly, professional and provided awesome service. The boat is clean, has everything you need including a bathroom AND usb charging ports(bring your own cord!) They provided coolers already filled with ice for our drinks, they have a nice Bluetooth sound system to listen to all your jams and there is plenty of room for everyone to pop out their dance moves. Overall it was an amazing experience and I can say I highly recommend it and will go back again!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

quotes.author: Apoorva Bhupathi
quotes.text: From start to end the process has been smooth and everyone has been nothing but kind and helpful. Shout out to captain steve who made sure our dog felt safe and comfortable! Had a beautiful and scenic experience with the family ❤️

quotes.author: Mallory Thum
quotes.text: Bachelorette Party approved!!! Was such a fun way to see Cape May, eat & drink, and celebrate the bride! Captain Kyle and his crew were awesome! Everyone had a great time and we can’t recommend them enough!

quotes.author: Alexander Stefanini (he/him)
quotes.text: Enjoyable boat ride with a nice owner. Price is reasonable. Trip was smooth. They made time for us to swim, which the kids really wanted. We’d come back to do fishing and other things. Thanks!

quotes.author: Nicholas Stamelos
quotes.text: My family recently went on a Cape May cycle cruise. The kids had a great time and really enjoyed the pedaling! I highly recommend!

quotes.author: Matt McCourt
quotes.text: I had a wonderful time and the guys are awesome! Super nice & friendly! Very clean as well, highly recommend!!
